nephesh-host.Label: Nephesh hosting reality
nephesh-host.body: NO free self-host box (AWS free=1GB OOMs, Oracle used up, no home hw). Nephesh runs on Groq free tier as substrate; Null-Prime prompts+attribution applied at UnifiedAIService layer so answers are Nephesh-branded regardless of engine. Self-host is a later upgrade (kit in nephesh/).

groq-native.Label: Groq is the live engine
groq-native.body: NEPHESH_BASE_URL unset => Groq is first available provider, serves ALL AI surfaces branded Nephesh. 3 GROQ keys rotate on 429 (same model, no help for refusals). Refusal-failover needs a DIFFERENT provider (add GEMINI_API_KEY).

ec2-access.Label: EC2 access
ec2-access.body: Key lost; use EC2 Instance Connect (browser), no .pem recoverable. IP 44.236.219.63, us-west-2 Oregon, instance i-0709a9d47e503384f. searxng t3.micro cannot host a model; give it 1GB swap.

adsterra.Label: Adsterra dead-ends
adsterra.body: API dashboard-only; banner anti-adblock codes don't exist in account; adult toggle can't be disabled once on; Impact.com closed until 50K/mo traffic.

budget.Label: Budget
budget.body: $0 budget, ad-revenue model. Flag any spend before incurring it.

branch.Label: Session branch workflow
branch.body: Develop on branch claude/truegle-company-skills-af5avu; push to that branch AND fast-forward main.

test-db.Label: Local test Postgres
test-db.body: role=truegle db=truegle_dev data=/tmp/pgdata-truegle. Start: sudo -u postgres /usr/lib/postgresql/16/bin/pg_ctl -D /tmp/pgdata-truegle start. sslmode=disable for local.

spa-routing.Label: SPA route rule (ponytail)
spa-routing.body: New client route needs BOTH public/_redirects (->/_index 200) AND public/_headers (Content-Type text/html). JSX-containing config files must be .jsx not .js.

groq-70b.Label: Default Groq model = 70B
groq-70b.body: GROQ_MODEL default bumped 8b-instant -> llama-3.3-70b-versatile (8B gave shallow summaries). Free-tier; multi-key rotation covers TPM.

transcripts-invidious.Label: Transcripts via Invidious
transcripts-invidious.body: Fetch captions from Invidious/Piped front-ends first (their IPs, not ours) to dodge YouTube rate-limit; direct scrape is fallback. Morty result-proxy can't scrape (strips <script>).

share-store.Label: Share store = Postgres
share-store.body: Shareable persistent threads use existing Postgres (shared_threads, migration 008), NOT Cloudflare KV — true $0/zero-ops.

multiselect-primary.Label: Multi-select design
multiselect-primary.body: Modes multi-select blends AI framing. On /search the PRIMARY mode stays single (drives sources/perspectives/OSINT routing); extra lenses only affect AI summary + follow-up chat, to avoid destabilizing the results pipeline.

osint-graph.Label: OSINT graph (GraphiPy)
osint-graph.body: OSINT investigations rendered as GraphiPy-model node/edge graph (OsintGraphService) with Gephi CSV + JSON export. User called it brilliant — keep.

no-jailbreak.Label: No jailbreaks
no-jailbreak.body: Won't build safety-bypasses. Real goal (fewer false denials on lawful requests) handled via refusal-failover + prompt-authorization + eventual self-hosted uncensored Nephesh.

purple-rename.Label: Purple = Perspectives
purple-rename.body: Purple MODE renamed Skeptical->Perspectives (labels/hook/landing). The skeptical bias LENS in PerspectiveSelector is a different concept, left as-is.

email-config.Label: config.email
email-config.body: Has resend + smtp. Previously TWO email keys collided (smtp overrode resend -> Resend email dead); fixed by merging. Keep merged.

migrations.Label: DB migrations
migrations.body: Never wired to deploy. Apply with: cd apps/backend && DATABASE_URL=... npm run migrate (idempotent). Latest = 008_add_shared_threads.

prod-migrate.Label: Run migration 008 on prod
prod-migrate.body: shared_threads table must exist in prod or /s share links + investigation graphs 500. Run npm run migrate against prod DB after deploy.

security-subagent.Label: Nephesh anti-injection security sub-agent
security-subagent.body: Persistent guard screening chat/OSINT inputs for prompt-injection/abuse so Nephesh isn't an attack surface. NOT started.

headless-osint.Label: Agent headless-browser OSINT
headless-osint.body: Let agent drive project Chromium for research needing browser actions + vetted OSS OSINT tools in a sandbox. Largest/most security-sensitive. NOT started.

persistent-user-memory.Label: Cross-session per-user saved investigations
persistent-user-memory.body: Server-side saved-threads list so Nephesh recalls a user's prior investigations. shared_threads is the foundation. NOT started.

adsterra-zones.Label: Adsterra zone replacement
adsterra-zones.body: Zone replacement targeted ~2026-07-16. Only the yellow 'claim this spot' ad slot is active; all others disabled.

graphipy-clarified.Label: Graphipy purpose clarified
graphipy-clarified.body: Graphipy was for AGENT memory between sessions + token costs (THIS memory system), not just OSINT. OSINT graph kept as a bonus.
